records.full_paragraph: This is intimate before it is theoretical. I can question a memory, revise my identity, fail to recognise myself in a portrait, or discover that an apparent certainty was mistaken. The questioning, failure and discovery are nevertheless present. What is at issue is not whether my description of myself is correct, but the presence within which correctness and error matter at all. Taylor's *Definition of God*, in its return to Zero, puts the pressure directly: “I am undeniable, though nowhere to be seen.” The word *I* here does not certify everything I say about myself. It names the first-person presence which an account of those sayings already enacts.

records.full_paragraph: The finding can be stated in its fact/contents form. The fact of first-person immediacy is undeniable by definition: any denial of it is performed in the presence it denies. Its contents are not. A thought, a doubting, a self-image — and the thinking-thing a *res cogitans* names — remain determinate occurrences within that presence, corrigible like every determination. The classical reification converted the condition of appearing into one more appearance and then treated that conversion as capture of the condition; the essay's crossed zero names the resulting occlusion `Ø`. Denying the fact is impossible; reifying it is the opposite error; defined indefinability holds both edges at once.

records.full_paragraph: A biography can identify a particular person. A physiological account can identify conditions of an experience. An introspective account can describe what that experience feels like. None becomes worthless because it does not exhaust the Subject. Each becomes more exact when it states what it determines and does not promote that determination into the whole reality of the one concerned. An account [determines through a cut](C03-Determination.md): it selects, excludes and relates. Its [fidelity](C02-Faithful-Definition.md) keeps that selection answerable to the person or appearing it concerns.

records.full_paragraph: Several things usually called “self” must therefore remain distinguishable. **Selfing** is an activity of appropriation: a changing determination is taken as mine, joined to the claim of what I am, and installed as the owner of the field. The **self-thing** is that determination treated as self-subsisting ground. A **bounded self**, by contrast, is a real situated horizon: this embodied life, with its history, limitations and capacity to be addressed. Its dependence does not make it unreal. **Subjectivity-as-such** names the unobjectifiable determining presence, while the capitalised **Self**, in this project's full symbolic use, names the whole relation of Subject and its objective internality, not the Subject isolated from manifestation.

records.full_paragraph: In [luminous self-apprehension](../arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md), appearing and its knowing belong to one act. The crystal displays a reflected blue; its display is not its recognition of blue. Taylor's comparison brings this operation into defined indefinability: the one knowing the appearance remains present through the knowing, while an image of that one is another appearance. The Śaiva distinction between luminous appearing and reflective awareness makes self-apprehension active; defined indefinability keeps the present act distinct from every image made of it.

records.full_paragraph: Four reflective acts produce three levels of difference in the p.74 account. The first two cooperate in constituting *bheda*, the separated individual and its objects. Holding their relation gives *bhedābheda*, unity-in-difference through the means of knowledge. Return beyond the merged determination gives *abheda*, undivided unity. The fourth act is not a fourth level appended to these three; it releases the achieved union from becoming another final object.

records.full_paragraph: An evaluator's approval states success under its criterion. A claim that the criterion itself became revisable needs evidence of which governing rule changed, how the change was authorised and which later act inherited it. The old evaluator can remain useful for a bounded comparison; its approval alone does not establish those further events. The before-and-after operation must become available to inspection, with a route through which affected sources, users, collaborators or material consequences can contest the revision. This is a relational test inside the field, with its own declared conditions of observation.
records.exact_mistaken_stronger_proposition: Approval by the old evaluator proves its criterion became revisable and inherited.
records.actual_text_or_source_feature_making_inf: Evaluator success concerns one rule; rule-change authority and subsequent act need their own evidence.
records.necessary_information_lost_if_removed: Bounded valid comparison remains useful while stronger architectural change retains additional trace/contest burden.

records.full_paragraph: Summing terms and dividing one by another perform different acts. An [accountable ratio](../arguments/A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md) keeps the terms and their comparison available for reckoning even where the same numbers recur. Equality of numerical results does not make those operations interchangeable. Operational parity applies the same demand to philosophy and code. If a formal or philosophical distinction is said to motivate a feature, identify the technical operation corresponding to that distinction and the consequence by which its presence or absence can be discriminated. A successful implementation check establishes that stated operational consequence. The metaphysical argument retains its own warrant; the implementation neither borrows nor cancels it.
records.exact_mistaken_stronger_proposition: Coincident numeric values make summing and dividing the same act, or implementation certifies metaphysics.
records.actual_text_or_source_feature_making_inf: Sum/division have different operations; technical mapping yields a specified discriminating consequence.
records.necessary_information_lost_if_removed: Exact act/value distinction and independent metaphysical/implementation warrants remain.

records.full_paragraph: A named distinction becomes [an accountable reckoning](../etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md#count-to-account) when its criterion, source and consequence can be examined through the retrieval, retention, evaluation or action said to carry it. Comparison must distinguish an implementation error, an inadequate operational mapping and a test that cannot discriminate the claim. Keeping those outcomes separate allows revision without making either technical success or failure a blanket verdict on the philosophical field.
records.exact_mistaken_stronger_proposition: Any technical failure is a blanket philosophical verdict.
records.actual_text_or_source_feature_making_inf: Error, inadequate mapping and nondiscriminating test are different causes of an outcome.

records.full_paragraph: The source-return test makes the three findings concrete. A correction that never reaches the intended map can expose a broken implementation. A corrected map with no bearing on the decision can expose a mistaken claim about what actually governs selection. An unchanged route in a task that never uses the gate can expose an inadequate test. [Epistemic Cultivation](C46-Epistemic-Cultivation.md) retains the finding in the next revision; [Deferential Intelligence](C47-Deferential-Intelligence.md) lets the encounter reach the receiving model or governing condition. Parity succeeds as a discipline when it can revise its own criterion without erasing what the prior test showed.
records.exact_mistaken_stronger_proposition: Broken implementation, irrelevant map and unexercised test establish the same finding.
records.actual_text_or_source_feature_making_inf: Correction not reaching map, map not influencing decision and unused gate expose different failed steps.
records.necessary_information_lost_if_removed: Revisable parity criterion retains the particular evidence rather than erasing prior result.

records.full_paragraph: A completed account can hide the conditions that gave it authority. The return therefore asks who speaks, through which instrument, under what permission, with which exclusions and costs. Name needs its coequal Power relation: Truth/Mind/Word/Logos/Son/Image cannot replace Play/Need/Sacrifice/Decision/Love/Work. An articulated result has passed through work and decision, not words alone.

records.full_paragraph: An articulated account returns through [the practice and address which bear it](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/language-symbol-dialogue/DEVELOPMENT.md#language-account-return) when a reply can reach its source, materially relevant criterion or subsequent act. A speaker can discover an assumption which had determined the question; another answer can change the interpretation under which someone was received. A warranted correction or the reasons for retaining a fitting condition then become available to the next act. Keeping a reply without a route into that inquiry does not perform this return.
records.exact_mistaken_stronger_proposition: Keeping a reply performs return even when it cannot enter the next inquiry.
records.actual_text_or_source_feature_making_inf: Reply can expose assumption, reception or materially relevant condition; correction or fitting-retention reasons become inherited.
